16.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
16.text: "So... Your Majesty. You are aware that nobody in Lespia nor our alliance supports this visit."

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: We eased to a stop at the entrance of the Yellow House. I stepped out onto the cobblestone driveway. The building itself was a small but imposing structure of classical design, its yellow-painted walls standing out boldly against the greenery of the park.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: Our convoy commenced its journey, a series of sleek black cars gliding through the Lespian capital's bustling streets.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: When we arrived in Perla, the press surged forward at me like a relentless horde -- shoving their cameras and microphones my way.

20.speaker: Narrator
20.text: As I stood there, absorbed in thought, the doors opened and Prime Minister Alvarez came in.

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: The elegantly crafted vessel was engraved with intricate designs -- delicate floral patterns interwoven with abstract shapes that reminded me of medieval Rezenid motifs.

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: As I waited for Prime Minister Alvarez, my attention was captured by a mysterious-looking teapot, resplendent in its golden sheen.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: Their shouts and pleas for attention clashed with the stoic demeanor of the Lespian security guards. These guards, clad in crisp, dark uniforms, formed a protective barrier around us, their eyes scanning for any reporter daring enough to breach their formation.

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: I was led into the waiting room -- a space with an understated elegance, furnished with leather chairs and a mahogany table. Sunlight filtered through lace curtains, casting soft patterns on the floor.

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: I leaned in closer, observing the way the light played off its surface. The piece was definitely made out of Rizian gold and looked far too ancient for its well-maintained shape.

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: I wondered if it was an original Rizian artifact or an unrelated gift from another foreign dignitary. Whatever it was, I questioned why such a valuable artifact was left out in the open like this.

29.speaker: Narrator
29.text: But then again, those who were allowed into this room -- world leaders and people of stature -- would probably have the common sense not to disturb this priceless relic.

30.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
30.text: "I see you immediately spotted your kingdom's gold, Your Majesty."

31.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
31.text: "It is an ancient Rezenid artifact, uncovered in southern Lespia. Quite a valuable item, I've been told."

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: He offered his hand and I shook it.

34.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
34.text: "Please. Let's get comfortable while we discuss our matters."

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: On his gesture, we moved to the sofas and sat down.

36.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
36.text: "But since I still see Rizia as a potential partner in the region, I'm showing my respects to you."

37.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
37.text: "Lespia does not approve of your invasion. And unless that reality does not change, there is not much I can offer you."

38.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
38.text: "...But I guess you knew that already."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "We don't need to let our agreement with Prime Minister Saltana sour our relations with Lespia."

40.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
40.text: "So... Your Majesty. I must say nobody in my government supports this visit."
40.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == true) == false)

44.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
44.text: "So... Your Majesty. It's good to see you again."
44.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == true) == false)

45.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
45.text: "They believe Rizia is aggressively trying to cut Lespia out of Southern Merkopa."

49.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
49.text: "Despite your attempts to block our efforts in Morella, I must add."

50.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
50.text: "So... Your Majesty. It's good to see you again."
50.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == true) == false)

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "Well, I'm here to discuss all of that today."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "It's good to see you too, Prime Minister Alvarez."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "I hope we can set a few things straight today."

64.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
64.text: "So... Your Majesty. I must say nobody in my government supports this visit."

65.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
65.text: "You have already spread lies about our involvement in Zille and acted quite antagonistically against us."

66.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
66.text: "My government believes Rizia is getting increasingly hostile and starting to pose a threat to stability in Southern Merkopa."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "And my council believes Lespia was also behind the border incident with Pales."

69.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
69.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == false

70.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
70.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == false) == false

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "And my council believes Lespia was behind the border incident with Pales -- trying to cut Rizia out of Aureus."
71.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == false

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "They can believe what they want, Mr. Alvarez. But since you've been so kind to invite us here, you must have a different belief."

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "The same goes for me, Mr. Alvarez. But here we are."

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "No need to start on the wrong foot here. There are matters we need to discuss."

77.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
77.text: "Interesting fantasies and theories they've got there."

78.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
78.text: "That sort of thinking is quite dangerous, Your Majesty."

81.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
81.text: "But first let's take a step back and start our discussion in a calm manner."

82.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
82.text: "Then let's take a step back and start our discussion in a calm manner."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "The evidence is clear. No need to deny it any longer."

91.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
91.text: "Then let's dive straight into it, Your Majesty."

92.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
92.text: "Why did Rizia publish this so-called evidence? You did not even have a dialogue with me about it until now."

93.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
93.text: "Does Rizia really want to make an enemy of Lespia, Your Majesty?"

94.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
94.text: "So, I would firstly extend my thanks for signing the gas deal with us."

98.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
98.text: "You will not regret working with LesPower."

99.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
99.text: "Therefore, I would firstly want to extend my thanks again for cooperating with LesPower on Aureus."
99.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LesPower_Buy_HighPrices"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false)

103.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
103.text: "It is a greatly beneficial deal for both of our countries."

104.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
104.text: "I've heard from Mr. Reinhart that you did not agree to the prices in our gas offer."
104.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LesPower_Buy_HighPrices"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Duke_SellGas"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.LesPower_ShortTermDeal"] == false)

105.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
105.text: "Is there something wrong, Your Majesty? I thought Rizia wanted the energy from Aureus."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "Your prices are unacceptable. That would be our most expensive import deal to date."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "Of course we want to have access to the energy. But if you think you can threaten me with it, you're wrong."

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "I'm sorry, Mr. Alvarez but I simply cannot accept those prices. After all the compromise we've given, I believe we deserve better than this."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "We don't want anything to do with it anymore, now that Lespia controls it."

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "Thank you, Mr. Alvarez. I'd like to believe we can achieve more together."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "We are glad to have reached a peaceful resolution on Aureus."

118.speaker: Player_Romus
118.text: "The price was a little too steep, but I'm happy to have reached an agreement."

119.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
119.text: "Unfortunately it's not Lespia but the market that decides on the prices."

121.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
121.text: "But I would have preferred to have reached an agreement on the MITZ as well."
121.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == false)

122.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
122.text: "And I'm also glad you and I are still on the same page regarding the MITZ."

129.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
129.text: "I would have preferred to have reached an agreement on the predicament we have with the MITZ."
129.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LesPower_Buy_HighPrices"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Duke_SellGas"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.LesPower_ShortTermDeal"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == false)

130.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
130.text: "Therefore, I would firstly want to extend my thanks for being on our side regarding the MITZ predicament."
130.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LesPower_Buy_HighPrices"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Duke_SellGas"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.LesPower_ShortTermDeal"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == false) == false)

131.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
131.text: "We will teach them not to mess with our interests."

132.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
132.text: "One moment you tell me we're on the same side. The next you're making all kinds of deals behind my back."

139.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
139.text: "We didn't need to go through all this renegotiation rigamarole. Don't you think so?"

140.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
140.text: "That's right. I know all about your agreement with Saltana."

141.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
141.text: "You're trying to screw us over, Your Majesty. It's plain and simple."

142.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
142.text: "You are allowing the Morellan government to take control of our shares in the operations... Just like that..."

143.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
143.text: "You're screwing us over, Your Majesty. It's as simple as that."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "I'm glad to be on the same side with Lespia on this matter."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "That's right, Mr. Alvarez. If they thought we'd let go of our control without a fight, they'd never been so wrong."

150.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
150.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_MorellaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_MorellaPipeline_Completed"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == false) == false

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "There could have been past mistakes, Mr. Alvarez. That doesn't mean we cannot work together."

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "Nobody's trying to screw over anyone. I'm just taking the options that are in the best interests of Rizia."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "Look, Mr. Alvarez. There is no hostility from Rizia towards Lespia. However, you must finally learn that Rizia is not going to be bullied."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "Are you saying it is really that easy to screw over Lespia?"

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "What's done is done, Mr. Alvarez. Let's talk about how we can still work together."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "You should be happy that I didn't vote for nationalization."

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "It's part of the plan, Mr. Alvarez. Having long negotiations doesn't mean we'll reach a conclusion, after all."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "Thank you but we don't need energy imports at the moment. There will be no deal, I'm afraid."

172.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
172.text: "But I would have preferred an understanding regarding the MITZ."
172.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == false)

173.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
173.text: "Well, at least, we can agree on the situation with the MITZ."

174.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
174.text: "We cannot simply manipulate the market and give Rizia an edge over everyone else now, can we?"

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "We both know that you can. And you *should*, if you want our business to continue."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "Oh, please. I am not an idiot, Mr. Alvarez. I'm here to negotiate a better price."

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "Actually we don't need energy imports at the moment. I'm not looking for any deal on this, I'm afraid."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "Well, I'm here to discuss precisely that."

181.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
181.text: "No, Your Majesty. I believe I cannot help you with a discount."

182.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
182.text: "I believe I still cannot help you with a discount."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "Please, Mr. Alvarez. Be reasonable. You don't want to lose Rizia as a partner."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "If you don't, I'm afraid there will be no energy partnership."

194.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
194.text: "I want to help you but you are putting me in a tough spot."

195.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
195.text: "Lespia is a democracy, Your Majesty. Unfortunately, I don't have the authority to manipulate that."

196.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
196.text: "Lespia is a democracy, Your Majesty. Unfortunately, I don't have the authority to manipulate that."
196.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Renegotiation"] == true)

197.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
197.text: "Rizia must first show that it can be trusted."

198.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
198.text: "Best interests, really? Well, they are definitely not in our interest."

201.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
201.text: "I'm just telling you what you have done and how we perceive it."

202.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
202.text: "Of course. We very much believe in cooperation here in Lespia."

204.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
204.text: "Yes. Let's see if we can still do that."

205.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
205.text: "Not funny, Your Majesty. I've already told you about my intentions."

206.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
206.text: "Look. We very much believe in cooperation here in Lespia -- as well as second chances."

207.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
207.text: "You might be enjoying the occasional visit to Morella, Your Majesty, but I certainly do not."

209.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
209.text: "You could have just refused to come to the table in the first place."

221.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
221.text: "You're trying to screw us over in the MITZ and it is plain to see."

222.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
222.text: "So, why would I take such a risk for you, after you went against us in the MITZ?"

223.speaker: Player_Romus
223.text: "Because I know about Lespia's involvement in the Zille bombing, Mr. Alvarez..."

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "I thought Lespia knew how to do business. With this attitude, you'll lose all of your partners in no time."

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "Are you not willing to make any compromise?"

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "Please, Mr. Alvarez. I came all the way here to negotiate this."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "You know that nothing is resolved about the MITZ, Mr. Alvarez. It's not a done deal."

231.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
231.text: "You are free to select your partners, Your Majesty."

232.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
232.text: "If you're willing to compromise your position on the MITZ, I can try to help you."

233.speaker: Narrator
233.text: He didn't react for a while. His eyebrow appeared frozen in a raised position.

234.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
234.text: "Did Mr. Smolak tell you this? Sounds like his brand."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "Who's the enemy here? I thought Lespia would be against the Wehzek takeover. This whole incident allowed President Smolak to take Zille hostage."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "Rizia was not behind the explosion, Mr. Alvarez."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "I'm sorry, but the world needs to know the truth."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "No. Despite everything, we still believe in cooperation."

242.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
242.text: "The truth, you say? That's a strong word to use."

243.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
243.text: "Only according to your reports... The truth is a slippery concept, Your Majesty."

244.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
244.text: "You've clearly answered your own question there."

245.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
245.text: "The enemy is President Smolak and his militarist government."

246.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
246.text: "Well, my government thinks you're here to threaten Lespia."

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "You'd better cooperate, Mr. Alvarez. Because I know about Lespia's involvement in the Zille bombing, you see..."

254.speaker: Player_Romus
254.text: "I thought Lespia knew how to do business. With this attitude, you'll lose all of your partners in no time."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "Are you not willing to make any compromise?"

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "Please, Mr. Alvarez. I came all the way here to negotiate this."

257.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
257.text: "Perhaps I can arrange something... For the sake of our friendship."

258.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
258.text: "But it will be one hell of a task to get people to agree to this."

259.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
259.text: "There is something I wanted to ask of you."

260.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
260.text: "Okay. We'll supply Rizia with the energy it needs. From 7 Arcasian Liras per thousand cubic meters."

261.speaker: Narrator
261.text: He sighed and then offered his hand with a smile.

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "And that's a deal, Mr. Alvarez. Thank you." [-1 Budget per Turn, +2 Energy per Turn]

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "That's a fair number but Rizia is an exceptional partner in the region. I still believe Lespia should recognize that by giving us an even better price."

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "Alright. It's a deal then." [-1 Budget per Turn, +2 Energy per Turn]

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "I'm afraid I still cannot agree to that."

268.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
268.text: "That is very unfortunate, Your Majesty. It seems we won't be reaching an agreement."

269.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
269.text: "I'm afraid we will both be returning with empty hands. No energy deals here today."

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "Lespia is the side that's being greedy here."

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "I am, Mr. Alvarez. As a matter of fact, my intention has never been to give Morella and Valgsland what they want. The voting was just a ploy."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "I am also free to tell the world about Lespia's involvement in the Zille bombing, Mr. Alvarez..."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "Fine. We don't need an energy deal from Lespia."

280.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
280.text: "But I'm sure we can cooperate on other subjects. So let's just move on."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "If you're going to give me a good price, I'm willing to do that."

283.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
283.text: "Fine. Then I cannot help you with the energy. I'm sorry, Your Majesty."

284.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
284.text: "We can already start supplying Rizia with energy as a token of good faith. From 7 Arcasian Liras per thousand cubic meters."

285.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
285.text: "Don't agree to their resolution. Help us sabotage the deal, and you will have your energy."

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "And that's a deal, Mr. Alvarez. Thank you." [-1 Budget per Turn, +2 Energy per Turn]

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "I think Lespia's shares in the MITZ should be worth a lot more than that, Mr. Alvarez."

288.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
288.text: "This is the best price I can give."

295.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
295.text: "Great to do business with Rizia, Your Majesty."

297.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
297.text: "Would you like a drink, Your Majesty?"

298.speaker: Narrator
298.text: He walked to a wooden cabinet full of liquor bottles.

299.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
299.text: "And I know what you've done behind closed doors. Trying to push us out of the MITZ."

300.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
300.text: "You're desperately trying to keep your shares by teaming up with the commies."

301.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
301.text: "Well, in any case... As long as you continue working with them, you cannot expect the Lespian parliament to sympathize with Rizia."

302.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
302.text: "You must be really desperate to team up with the commies."

303.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
303.text: "You will sabotage the deal, I'll handle Prime Minister Saltana so we both keep our shares, and thus we'll have the doors open for Lespia to develop a strategic partnership with Rizia."

304.speaker: Narrator
304.text: He tapped his fingers aggressively on the table.

305.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
305.text: "Come on, Your Majesty. You promised to support us and then you did the complete opposite."

306.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
306.text: "There is simply no justification for that action."

310.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
310.text: "Maybe even third chances, since you *promised* to support us but rather did the opposite."

311.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
311.text: "If we are to put that behind us, you have to make sure this MITZ deal never happens."

315.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
315.text: "If we veto the proposed nationalization plan, it cannot be implemented."

316.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
316.text: "If we veto the proposed renegotiation plan, it cannot be implemented."

318.speaker: Player_Romus
318.text: "I'll keep that in mind but I can give you no promises."

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "I'll take your word for it, Mr. Alvarez. Don't worry. That resolution will not reach the light of day." [Binding Promise]

320.speaker: Player_Romus
320.text: "What's done is done. I believe we've been through this. Let's talk about other matters."

329.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
329.text: "You can't seriously believe working with Mr. Hegel be beneficial for Rizia in the long-term."

330.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
330.text: "But fine. If you don't want to discuss this, we won't."

332.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
332.text: "You've said that before, Your Majesty. I hope I can trust you this time."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "I promise you, Mr. Alvarez. I will block the agreement."

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "That was just part of the plan, Mr. Alvarez. Don't worry. We won't give them an inch from the MITZ."

337.speaker: Player_Romus
337.text: "With all due respect, I am only on the side of Rizia, Mr. Alvarez. I'm not doing this for Lespia."

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "Look, Mr. Alvarez. I have evidence of your involvement in Zille bombing. You will vote for our version of the agreement, and I will not release the evidence. How about that?"

346.speaker: Narrator
346.text: He poured water in one glass and whiskey in another. He handed me the water, sat back down and took a sip.

347.speaker: Narrator
347.text: He poured whiskey for himself, sat back down in front of me and took a long sip.

348.speaker: Narrator
348.text: He prepared two glasses of whiskey and handed me one.

351.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
351.text: "Your people have contacted us about the MITZ earlier. I believe Rizia wants to cooperate against Morella."

352.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
352.text: "You don't need to worry about Prime Minister Saltana. If we band together, we can *sway* her."

356.speaker: Player_Romus
356.text: "We are already on the same side on this. But I don't know if she's willing to budge."

359.speaker: Narrator
359.text: He didn't react for a while and looked at me with a raised eyebrow.

362.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
362.text: "Just to be clear. There cannot be any cooperation with Rizia after this."

363.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
363.text: "This is out of my hands now, Your Majesty. The sentiment in the Lespian parliament is now very... anti-Rizian, as you might expect."

364.speaker: Player_Romus
364.text: "I don't care about your parliament. You are the one who's in charge."

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "If you're not even willing to claim responsibility, then I'm afraid there won't be any business today."

366.speaker: Player_Romus
366.text: "Anti-Rizian? Is that some sort of a threat? Or are you trying to say it was just a lone wolf?"

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "Don't change the topic, Mr. Alvarez. I am here to discuss your involvement. It is out now. There is no reason to deny it any longer."

369.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
369.text: "Lespia is a democracy, Your Majesty. That might be hard for you to comprehend but I'm not behind every decision here."

370.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
370.text: "Okay, so you claim you already know. What is it do you still want to hear from me?"

377.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
377.text: "I just don't understand why you'd do anything like this while relations between our countries has been getting better."

378.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
378.text: "If you want any cooperation from Lespia, you *must* sabotage the deal you made with Morella and make sure the arrangement never comes to pass."
378.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true)

380.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
380.text: "Otherwise, I'm afraid we won't be able to maintain our partnership or pursue further agreements with Rizia."

383.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
383.text: "I'll be blunt. We are in a breaking point of Lespian-Rizian relations."

384.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
384.text: "And my people are now supportive of more aggressive policies against Rizia."

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "You cannot threaten me, Mr. Alvarez. This meeting is over."

386.speaker: Player_Romus
386.text: "What are you talking about? We know that Lespia is responsible for this. You committed an act of terror."

387.speaker: Player_Romus
387.text: "You'd better cooperate with me, Mr. Alvarez. I've also heard the public opinion is now against you. You sure you can get elected again?"

388.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
388.text: "Was this a personal triumph for you, Mr. Toras?"

389.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
389.text: "You should know that your little tricks did not gain you any sympathy in Lespia."

390.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
390.text: "Leave that up to me, Your Majesty."

391.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
391.text: "I just need you to maintain the pressure and vote together with us on the resolution."

400.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
400.text: "I find your initiative to build a pipeline from Morella intriguing."
400.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_PromiseITZSupport_Late"] == false) == false)

407.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
407.text: "When you made your deal with Morella at the expense of Lespia, you agreed to supply that commie she-devil Saltana with energy, did you not?"
407.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Completed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_PromiseITZSupport_Late"] == false)

408.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
408.text: "On top of your cooperation with Morella at the expense of Lespia, I find your initiative to build a pipeline disrespectful."
408.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Completed"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_PromiseITZSupport_Late"] == false)

409.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
409.text: "I find your initiative to connect the pipelines from Morella and Derdia intriguing."
409.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_PromiseITZSupport_Late"] == false) == false)

410.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
410.text: "You even managed to bring the Derdians into this."

413.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
413.text: "Wouldn't it be even better if we extend the pipeline to Lespia and create a proper energy network in Southern Merkopa?"

414.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
414.text: "Give us access to this energy network project. We'll handle the costs, connect the pipeline to Lespia and bring our own gas and oil into the mix."

415.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
415.text: "Do this for us, and we can still make amends."

416.speaker: Player_Romus
416.text: "Lespia is not going to threaten us, Mr. Alvarez. I am not desperate to make amends."

417.speaker: Player_Romus
417.text: "I cannot give you access to this network without consulting with our partners. And I believe they will oppose the idea. I'm sorry."

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "You should be the one making amends with us now, Mr. Alvarez. Don't forget about what we discussed regarding the evidence..."

420.speaker: Player_Romus
420.text: "Sounds good, Mr. Alvarez. I believe that's a deal." [Accept]

423.speaker: Player_Romus
423.text: "I cannot give you access to this network without consulting with our partners. And I believe they will oppose the idea. I'm sorry."

426.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
426.text: "Give us access to this energy network project. We'll handle the costs and connect the pipeline to Lespia and be part of this network through Rizia."

429.speaker: Player_Romus
429.text: "I'm sorry to disappoint you, Mr. Alvarez. But no."

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "Sounds good, Mr. Alvarez. I believe that's a deal." [Accept]

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "Fine, Mr. Alvarez. I'll give you access. But don't ever forget this." [Accept]

437.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
437.text: "You know... Wehlen is starting to create a lot of problems for the region. I have serious stability concerns."
437.conditionsRaw: (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_MorellaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_MorellaPipeline_Completed"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF"] == true) == false)

438.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
438.text: "Fine. We will pay for the access. We'll support the construction expenses of all the partners."

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "Sounds good, Mr. Alvarez. I believe that's a deal." [+2 Budget]

444.speaker: Narrator
444.text: He took a big gulp of his whiskey.

445.speaker: Player_Romus
445.text: "This is an extremely major incident, Mr. Alvarez. You cannot simply play ignorant. Rizia wants to see action from Lespia. Not the other way around."

446.speaker: Player_Romus
446.text: "Tell me. Why? What did Lespia hope to achieve with this?"

447.speaker: Player_Romus
447.text: "You have to pay for the incident. Not only it incited an international crisis, innocent people also lost their lives. You must claim responsibility."

451.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
451.text: "On top of that, you are going to grant us access to your pipeline project you initiated with Morella. We'll take on the costs and connect Lespia to Rizia."

452.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
452.text: "Do this and I'll make sure the Lespian government stays outside of Rizian affairs."

453.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
453.text: "You don't want Lespia to actively work against Rizian interests."

454.speaker: Player_Romus
454.text: "Fine. I will sabotage the deal. I don't want our relations with Lespia to suffer." [Binding Promise]

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: "Stop speaking like you have the upper hand, Mr. Alvarez. You are in no position to make demands."

457.speaker: Player_Romus
457.text: "You're going to *make sure*? We have proof that you've already actively worked against our interests."

458.speaker: Player_Romus
458.text: "I see the reality clear as day now. Lespia is nothing but a terrorist state."

460.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
460.text: "Your opinion will not change the reality of our situation."

461.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
461.text: "Don't expect Lespia to be supportive of your tyrannical regime anymore."

463.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
463.text: "I'm sorry you came all the way for this. But I believe we are done here."

465.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
465.text: "If I lose in the next elections, you'll be dealing with someone who clearly opposes your regime in its entirety. I wonder what you'll think of me then."

467.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
467.text: "Good. Certainly a step in the right direction."

469.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
469.text: "I refuse to accept any responsibility. You should have never published that investigation."

470.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
470.text: "If you're here to blackmail Lespia, we should end the meeting already. I am not going to announce anything or pay Rizia a single cent."

471.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
471.text: "You know... I have concerns about the stability of this region. And I know that you're funding the BFF with Rumburg."
471.conditionsRaw: (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_MorellaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_MorellaPipeline_Completed"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF"] == true)

472.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
472.text: "As much as I oppose the actions of the Wehzek government, and sympathize with the cause of the Bludish rebels..."

473.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
473.text: "This only resulted in President Smolak extending his powers and conducting a massive military operation right on our doorstep."

474.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
474.text: "Your Rumburgian allies are complicit in this instability. As much as I oppose the actions of the Wehzek government, and sympathize with the cause of the Bludish rebels..."

475.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
475.text: "The Wehzeks seized the assets of our companies and sent a wave of refugees towards our borders. They're escalating the problem."

482.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
482.text: "And now Smolak seems to be getting closer to Sordland. That can't be good for any of us."

483.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
483.text: "They also took part in the operation. Not only did they cripple the BFF, they destabilized the region even further."

484.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
484.text: "Be careful when you're dealing with their new president, Rayne. He might prove to be a real problem."
484.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Wehlen_JointOperation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Trade"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Trade"] == true)

488.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
488.text: "Be careful when you're dealing with President Smolak. He is getting increasingly out of hand."

489.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
489.text: "You know that Lespia also has a considerable number of Bludish people living inside our borders. We don't want the problems of Sordland and Wehlen to spread to our country."

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "Is this Mr. Rayne really that competent?"

493.speaker: Player_Romus
493.text: "Then I'd rather make friends with him."

494.speaker: Player_Romus
494.text: "With all due respect, how is this new information?"

495.speaker: Player_Romus
495.text: "Please, Mr. Alvarez. Stop. I'm not going to listen to you act all innocent and pass judgement like that. You blew up the entire Zille agreement."

499.speaker: Player_Romus
499.text: "You are already aware of our situation with him, Mr. Alvarez..."

500.speaker: Player_Romus
500.text: "I know. He really is an intriguing man."

503.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
503.text: "Let's just keep our eyes on him."

514.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
514.text: "Let's just keep an eye on them both."

519.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
519.text: "He seems like he's on the way to becoming the next President Smolak. We wouldn't want that."

521.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
521.text: "I'm also worried about Valgsland's closer ties with our northern neighbors."

522.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
522.text: "He is already getting closer to the communists."

523.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
523.text: "Hegel is desperately looking for partners to sway towards the CSP and fuel incidents to create division in Eastern Merkopa."

524.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
524.text: "We both need to be resilient against the Valgish threat. They are the real problem."

528.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
528.text: "I'm also worried about Valgsland's increasing pressure on our region."

529.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
529.text: "Be careful who you're dealing with, Your Majesty. You may be playing into their hands."

533.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
533.text: "They have unfortunately shown that they are quite capable of inciting revolutions in Rika and beyond."

534.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
534.text: "The world doesn't work on regional politics anymore. You have to be careful which sides you're dealing with."

535.speaker: Player_Romus
535.text: "Thank you for the advice, Mr. Alvarez."

536.speaker: Player_Romus
536.text: "That's why Lespia and Rizia must stay together."

537.speaker: Player_Romus
537.text: "That's exactly how the superpowers look at the world. I'm sorry but I don't intend to play the games of ATO or CSP."

538.speaker: Player_Romus
538.text: "Your comments are quite uncalled for. Why are you telling me this?"

539.speaker: Player_Romus
539.text: "Don't worry. I know exactly who I'm dealing with."

540.speaker: Player_Romus
540.text: "Of course you'd say that. ATO would like us to believe there is some sort of a *red threat*. I'm sorry, but I don't intend to play the games of ATO or CSP."

541.speaker: Player_Romus
541.text: "Don't worry. I know exactly what they're capable of."

542.speaker: Player_Romus
542.text: "While I agree with the sentiment, I don't think Valgsland poses a direct threat to Rizia."

544.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
544.text: "Valgsland has intelligence and propaganda networks all over Eastern Merkopa."

545.speaker: Player_Romus
545.text: "I don't think Valgsland poses any direct threat to Rizia."

547.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
547.text: "Regardless of your beliefs, sooner or later, you'll need to pick a side."

549.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
549.text: "It was just a simple advice. I apologize if I crossed a line."

550.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
550.text: "You might not see it yet, but I believe he intends to take Heljiland by force -- igniting a series of conflicts that we may find ourselves in the middle of."

551.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
551.text: "Look. I believe we should be on the same side against the commies. Rumburg must see the bigger picture."

552.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
552.text: "I know you have the ear of Queen Livingston."

553.speaker: Narrator
553.text: He took a sip from his glass and turned to me with a serious face.

554.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
554.text: "GRACE is an important force on this continent, and I hope you will be on the side of peace -- if it ever comes down to that."

555.speaker: Player_Romus
555.text: "GRACE is also worried about the expansion of the Contanan Security Pact. We are aligned on that matter."

556.speaker: Player_Romus
556.text: "Don't try to bring GRACE into this. We do not have a military alliance nor hold the keys to peace."

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "I disagree. GRACE has turned into nothing but Rumburg's playground, and it doesn't have any function other than economic cooperation."

558.speaker: Player_Romus
558.text: "Many would also argue that it is your alliance that stands in the way of peace and is escalating."

559.speaker: Player_Romus
559.text: "You are scared Rumburg will jump on the opportunity if Valgsland attacks Agnolia? And why should that even matter to me?"

560.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
560.text: "Are you really sympathetic to the very people who want to dispose of your whole family and political traditions if they get the chance?"

561.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
561.text: "Queen Beatrice certainly does hold the keys."

564.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
564.text: "Well, anyway... We are normalizing our relations with Rumburg and I just wanted to say that I need to talk to Queen Beatrice about all of this. Face to face."

565.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
565.text: "Can you extend your support in organizing such a visit? That would make things much smoother."

566.speaker: Player_Romus
566.text: "Of course I would. I'll make sure she hears your concerns."

567.speaker: Player_Romus
567.text: "If you want to visit Rumburg, just visit Rumburg. You don't need to involve me."

573.speaker: Player_Romus
573.text: "Are you really going to keep denying this?"

574.speaker: Player_Romus
574.text: "Stop pretending, Mr. Alvarez. The secret is out."

575.speaker: Player_Romus
575.text: "You made the whole Zille agreement collapse!"

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "What do you have to say for yourself?"

577.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
577.text: "Nothing. Because I have nothing to do with this."

578.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
578.text: "This is a Wehzek conspiracy, Your Majesty."

579.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
579.text: "Of course. Because I have nothing to do with this."

580.speaker: Player_Romus
580.text: "Here is the evidence. See for yourself."

581.speaker: Player_Romus
581.text: "Oh yes, it's genius. Wehlen has everything to gain from this and President Smolak is the perfect person to blame. You did well. But we'll publish it with the world soon enough."

582.speaker: Player_Romus
582.text: "I'm afraid we cannot conduct any diplomacy with your government until you acknowledge this act of terror. If you don't, we'll publish the evidence."

583.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
583.text: "Well, you don't need to do that."

584.speaker: Narrator
584.text: I handed him the evidence. He slowly went through the documents.

585.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
585.text: "I'm sorry this happened. I'll try to get to the bottom of this. But these need not be published anywhere."

590.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
590.text: "Destroy the evidence and I'll give you the deal you're asking for."

591.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
591.text: "Destroy the evidence and I'll support you in the final MITZ board vote."

592.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
592.text: "We can already start supplying Rizia with energy as a token of good faith. From 7 Arcasian Liras per thousand cubic meters."

593.speaker: Player_Romus
593.text: "And that's a deal, Mr. Alvarez. Thank you." [-1 Budget per Turn, +2 Energy per Turn]

594.speaker: Player_Romus
594.text: "I think this information should be worth a lot more than that, Mr. Alvarez."

595.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
595.text: "This is the best price I can give. I'm sorry."

598.speaker: Player_Romus
598.text: "I think this information should be worth a lot more than that, Mr. Alvarez."

599.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
599.text: "Don't push your luck, Your Majesty. This is the most I can do."

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "You'll have to do better if you need my help."

602.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
602.text: "Fine. Just release the information. I'm not going to be blackmailed."

603.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
603.text: "My government is strong enough to weather the backlash. And we can cause all kinds of problems for you if you openly declare yourself an enemy."

604.speaker: Player_Romus
604.text: "Okay. It's a deal, Mr. Alvarez." [-1 Budget per Turn, +2 Energy per Turn]

607.speaker: Narrator
607.text: He stood up and turned his back to me as he walked away.

608.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
608.text: "I believe the meeting is over. And I need a drink."

611.speaker: Narrator
611.text: He took another big gulp from his glass.

615.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
615.text: "I believe I don't have anything left to discuss with you, Your Majesty."

617.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
617.text: "Was there anything else we could do for each other?"

618.speaker: Player_Romus
618.text: "I request financial assistance from Lespia. Maybe we can talk about a possible trade deal?"

619.speaker: Player_Romus
619.text: "Our energy demands are rising rapidly. I want to buy energy from Lespia."

622.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
622.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option4"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 4) == false

624.speaker: Player_Romus
624.text: "No, Mr. Alvarez. Thank you for the meeting."

631.speaker: Player_Romus
631.text: "I want to talk to you about the Zille incident. You still didn't share anything about it with me."

632.speaker: Player_Romus
632.text: "There is actually something I want to talk to you about, Mr. Alvarez. I have proof of Lespian involvement in the Zille bombing..."
632.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_AskedLowerPrices"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_AskedLespianVoteITZ"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option1"] == false)

638.speaker: Narrator
638.text: I stood up and walked out of the room with quick steps.

641.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
641.text: "Look, Your Majesty. I am extremely sorry that such an incident occurred, but you have to trust me: I had no hand in this."

643.speaker: Player_Romus
643.text: "Are you really going to keep denying this?"

644.speaker: Player_Romus
644.text: "Stop pretending, Mr. Alvarez. The secret is out."

645.speaker: Player_Romus
645.text: "You made the whole Zille agreement collapse!"

646.speaker: Player_Romus
646.text: "What do you have to say for yourself?"

647.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
647.text: "Nothing. Because I have nothing to do with this."

648.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
648.text: "This is a Wehzek conspiracy, Your Majesty."

649.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
649.text: "Of course. Because I have nothing to do with it."

650.speaker: Player_Romus
650.text: "Here is the evidence. See for yourself."

651.speaker: Player_Romus
651.text: "Oh yes, it's genius. Wehlen has everything to gain from this and President Smolak is the perfect person to blame. You did well. But we'll publish it to the world soon enough."

652.speaker: Player_Romus
652.text: "I'm afraid we cannot conduct any diplomacy with your government until you acknowledge this act of terror. If you don't, we'll publicize the evidence."

653.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
653.text: "Well, you don't need to do that."

654.speaker: Narrator
654.text: I handed him the evidence. He slowly went through the documents.

655.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
655.text: "I'm sorry this happened. I'll try to get to the bottom of this. But these need not be published anywhere."

657.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
657.text: "Did Mr. Smolak tell you this? Sounds like his brand."

659.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
659.text: "Rest assured, I will demand an explanation from our intelligence services."

665.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

670.speaker: Player_Romus
670.text: "Certain people in Rizia believe Lespia had a hand in the incident at the Palesian border. What do you have to say about that?"
670.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option2"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option1"] == false

672.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
672.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option2"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option1"] == true

673.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
673.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option2"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option1"] == true) == false

674.speaker: Player_Romus
674.text: "We also have reasons to believe Lespia had a hand in the incident at the Palesian border. What do you have to say about that?"
674.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option2"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option1"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option2"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Lespia_Alvarez_Hub_Option1"] == true)

675.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
675.text: "Come on, Your Majesty. You are really sounding like Mr. Smolak now. You can't blame every incident on us."

676.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
676.text: "I thought the investigations were completed and you arrested the culprit. Why bring up such a ridiculous idea now?"

681.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
681.text: "Why would Lespia even do that? You are making no sense."

682.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
682.text: "I believe I have nothing else to say about this. So please, let's just move on."

689.speaker: Player_Romus
689.text: "We don't need to let our conflict with Pales sour our relations with Lespia."

690.speaker: Player_Romus
690.text: "Well, I'm here to discuss all of that today."

691.speaker: Player_Romus
691.text: "I'm concerned about the reaction of the ATO. Lespia has yet to announce any sanctions -- I hope you will not follow through."

692.speaker: Player_Romus
692.text: "I hope we can set a few things straight today."

694.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
694.text: "Do you think Rizia can get away with the invasion of Pales just like that?"

696.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
696.text: "Only if you're willing to stop the war and retreat."

697.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
697.text: "And why would I not follow through?"

698.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
698.text: "I have to point out that there is not much I can offer in our discussion unless Rizia stops the war and retreats."

699.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
699.text: "The Grand Duchy of Pales is an important partner of Lespia. We not only have deep economic ties but recently have been establishing military ties as well."

700.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
700.text: "There is no justification for this war and the ATO is discussing placing sanctions against Rizia."

701.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
701.text: "And if they go with it, you bet we will follow through as well. Not only with sanctions on Rizia but with our active support to Pales."

702.speaker: Player_Romus
702.text: "Active support? Are you saying Lespia will enter the war, Mr. Alvarez?"

703.speaker: Player_Romus
703.text: "I'm here for dialogue, Mr. Alvarez. You have to stop with the threats and look for a compromise."

704.speaker: Player_Romus
704.text: "I believe we can make a beneficial agreement for Lespia. Don't support Pales and we can share their resources or parts of Aureus with you."

705.speaker: Player_Romus
705.text: "If you do anything rash, Lespia will be obliterated. You can be sure of that, Mr. Alvarez. You don't want to go down that route."

709.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
709.text: "Rest assured, Lespia doesn't see or want Rizia as an enemy. However, as a member of the ATO, we must do what we must."

711.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
711.text: "You seem too confident. But what if Rumburg stops their support of you one day?"
711.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Operation1_TotalPlayer_Dead"] + Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Operation2_TotalPlayer_Dead"] >= 6) == false)

718.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
718.text: "You seem overconfident. Considering that Rizia has yet to capture any of their war goals."

719.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
719.text: "You seem overconfident. Considering that Rizia has already lost tens of thousands in the invasion."

720.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
720.text: "I'll say it again. Lespia is against this war and I have no choice but to support the defense of Pales -- whether directly or indirectly."

721.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
721.text: "You'd prefer it to be indirect, I'm sure."

722.speaker: Player_Romus
722.text: "You're bluffing. Lespia would never enter a direct war with us."

723.speaker: Player_Romus
723.text: "You can't threaten me. Even if Lespia enters the war -- we will not stop fighting."

724.speaker: Player_Romus
724.text: "I'd prefer that support to be nonexistent, Mr. Alvarez."

728.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
728.text: "Especially since you've in some way declared us the enemy by publishing all the nonsensical *proof* without consulting with us."

729.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
729.text: "I don't see any possibility of diplomacy between our countries anymore, Your Majesty".

733.speaker: Player_Romus
733.text: "I'd prefer that support to be nonexistent, Mr. Alvarez. We have proof of your involvement in the Zille bombing. You don't want that to be published, I'm sure."

735.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
735.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_StatusQuo"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Used_ExperimentalWeapons"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Media_Geopolitico_Support"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Military_Valgsland_AcceptNavalAid"] == false

736.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
736.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_StatusQuo"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Used_ExperimentalWeapons"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Media_Geopolitico_Support"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Military_Valgsland_AcceptNavalAid"] == false) == false

737.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
737.text: "You understand you're saying this as the invading side who is violating the sovereignty of an independent state, right?"

738.speaker: Player_Romus
738.text: "Let's be reasonable. Nobody wants more conflict and violence."

739.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
739.text: "I thought you were a more careful man."
739.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_StatusQuo"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Used_ExperimentalWeapons"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Media_Geopolitico_Support"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Military_Valgsland_AcceptNavalAid"] == false

740.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
740.text: "Tomorrow, I will be signing off on military support worth of ten billion Arcasian Liras to Pales, as well as sanctions against Rizia."
740.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_StatusQuo"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Used_ExperimentalWeapons"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Media_Geopolitico_Support"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Military_Valgsland_AcceptNavalAid"] == false) == false

741.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
741.text: "This is just the beginning, Your Majesty. Arcasia may also send a hundred billion Liras more to Pales -- especially if Rumburg gives any active support."

745.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
745.text: "You can do whatever you want with it. We won't be blackmailed by that."

746.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
746.text: "And how do you think you can hurt us with that after you decide to invade a sovereign state?"

747.speaker: Player_Romus
747.text: "It will hurt your election chances. You can at least veto the sanctions -- and we can destroy the evidence."

748.speaker: Player_Romus
748.text: "How about Lespia decides not to intervene and keep their support to Pales indirect and minimum -- and we will destroy the evidence."

749.speaker: Player_Romus
749.text: "Good. Then you won't mind if we publish it."

751.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
751.text: "And if more atrocities take place, we will think about intervening directly."

752.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
752.text: "Tomorrow, I have to sign off on military support worth of ten billion Arcasian Liras to Pales, as well as sanctions against Rizia."

753.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
753.text: "Believe me. I don't want to give any more money to Pales nor sever our relations with Rizia. But as a member of ATO, this much I have to do."

754.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
754.text: "If we can understand that, we can discuss about how to maintain our ties and how we can allow safe shipping lanes around the Sudis Sea during the war."

755.speaker: Player_Romus
755.text: "I understand, Mr. Alvarez. You gotta to what you gotta do. But you have to promise me that no more support will be given after that."

756.speaker: Player_Romus
756.text: "We don't want to damage our trade. Can't we discuss any compromise on the sanctions?"

757.speaker: Player_Romus
757.text: "If you're not willing to help me out, I won't offer any easy solutions for your shipping lanes. In fact, I will make things very hard for you."

763.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
763.text: "You are free to do whatever you want, Your Majesty."

764.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
764.text: "With which navy? Your fleet cannot even match the power of Pales."

765.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
765.text: "You cannot persuade me with unrealistic promises."

767.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
767.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_StatusQuo"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Used_ExperimentalWeapons"] < 0   and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Military_Valgsland_AcceptNavalAid"] == false

769.speaker: Narrator
769.text: He stared at me with furrowed brows.

770.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
770.text: "Just be prepared to face the consequences."

771.speaker: Player_Romus
771.text: "There's nothing left to understand. I see your stance clearly. Our meeting is over."

772.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
772.text: "Look, Your Majesty. The western powers have mostly condemned the invasion and ATO is preparing to put sanctions on Rizia."

773.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
773.text: "Lespia is under pressure from the international community to help support Pales. You see... We were their biggest business partners."

774.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
774.text: "I'm afraid there's nothing I can do for you anymore."

776.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
776.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true   and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Military_Valgsland_AcceptNavalAid"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Media_Geopolitico_Support"] == true

777.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
777.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true   and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Military_Valgsland_AcceptNavalAid"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Media_Geopolitico_Support"] == true) == false

778.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
778.text: "You may have started a major conflict which can have chain reactions all around Merkopa..."

780.speaker: Narrator
780.text: We both got up from our seats.

782.speaker: Player_Romus
782.text: "Your position seems too rigid. I don't see any true willingness to support Rizia. So there seems to be no point in any discussion."

783.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
783.text: "As much as I want to help you, my hands are tied. You must understand my position for us to discuss anything."

784.speaker: Player_Romus
784.text: "I understand, Mr. Alvarez. You can officially take on a pro-Pales stance, but I believe we can still arrange something in the background."

786.speaker: Player_Romus
786.text: "I understand your predicament. But Lespians know how to make beneficial deals and I want to offer you one for both of our benefit."

787.speaker: Player_Romus
787.text: "I'm not taking this personally. I know we can work something out. You are clever man, Mr. Alvarez. You know that Pales has no chance of winning. Be on the winning side."

788.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
788.text: "I don't know, Your Majesty. You've lost a lot of men."

795.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
795.text: "Palesian Defence Forces are still in control of key locations like Arces and Ziqes. I'm not sure if things are really looking good for your side."

797.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
797.text: "Well... Your forces have already occupied both Arces and Ziqes. That is definitely one hell of an achievement, I must admit."
797.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Operation1_TotalPlayer_Dead"] + Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Operation2_TotalPlayer_Dead"] >= 10) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true)

801.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
801.text: "Well... Your forces have already occupied Arces. That is one hell of a strategic location to control, I must admit."

805.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
805.text: "Well... Your forces have already occupied Ziqes. That is one hell of a strategic location to control, I must admit."
805.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Operation1_TotalPlayer_Dead"] + Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Operation2_TotalPlayer_Dead"] >= 10) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true) == false)

806.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
806.text: "I believe our support can easily allow Pales to stand their ground. You don't want to deplete your gold reserves in a war of attrition, Your Majesty."

807.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
807.text: "But anyway... Let's talk about what you can offer us."

808.speaker: Narrator
808.text: He tapped his fingers on his knee, waiting for me to speak.

809.speaker: Player_Romus
809.text: "What will Lespia earn from this? You don't need to do this. Let me make an offer."

810.speaker: Player_Romus
810.text: "I understand your predicament. But Lespians know how to make beneficial deals and I want to offer you one for both of our benefit."

811.speaker: Player_Romus
811.text: "If you're going to continue with your threats, I will end the meeting here."

816.speaker: Player_Romus
816.text: "I will destroy the evidence of Lespian involvement in the Zille bombing if you will do your best to block the sanctions against us."

817.speaker: Player_Romus
817.text: "I will destroy the evidence of Lespian involvement in the Zille bombing if you stop sending military equipment to Pales."

818.speaker: Player_Romus
818.text: "I will destroy our evidence of Lespian involvement in the Zille bombing as a token of good faith. I will ask nothing in return."

820.speaker: Narrator
820.text: He looked at me with surprise in his eyes.

821.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
821.text: "This is a good start, Your Majesty."

828.speaker: Player_Romus
828.text: "There must be something I can do for ATO or Lespia that will help with the sanctions."

829.speaker: Player_Romus
829.text: "I will pay you if you stop sending military equipment to Pales."

830.speaker: Player_Romus
830.text: "Just be direct with me. Is there anything I can offer you for Lespian support?"

831.speaker: Player_Romus
831.text: "Thank you, Mr. Alvarez. I'm glad we reached some understanding."

832.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
832.text: "I can't promise anything about Arcasia but I will do my best about the Lespian sanctions."

833.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
833.text: "You know there is no way I can support this war, Your Majesty."

837.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
837.text: "The most I can offer is to veto the sanctions against Rizia when they reach me."

841.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
841.text: "The most I can offer is decreasing and eventually stopping our military equipment support to Pales."

842.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
842.text: "Hmm... There is something that we may want."

843.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
843.text: "If there is one thing that can stop ATO from acting overtly aggressive towards Rizia -- that is the island of Caleqabiz."

844.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
844.text: "I want you to extend your pipeline project with Morella to Lespia. We will be given full access."

845.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
845.text: "And you will take care of the construction costs."

846.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
846.text: "Lease it to ATO -- until the Valgish threat in the Antacean ceases -- through Lespia."

847.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
847.text: "You'll get Pales in exchange for a tiny island. Not a bad deal if you ask me."

849.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
849.text: "Or... You can give something the ATO wants."

850.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
850.text: "Alright. I will stop it if you will pay for the entire value of the military equipment that was planned to be sent."

855.speaker: Player_Romus
855.text: "I'm afraid we don't have the capacity to pay that now."
855.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 2) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_LespianSupport"] == 2) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_LespianSupport"] == 2) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 3) == false)

856.speaker: Player_Romus
856.text: "That is too much. I cannot do that."

862.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
862.text: "Thank you, Mr. Toras. I'm glad we reached some understanding."

864.speaker: Narrator
864.text: We both got up from our seats.

867.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
867.text: "Or... You can give us something the ATO wants."

868.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
868.text: "If there is one thing that can stop ATO from acting overtly aggressive towards Rizia -- that is the island of Caleqabiz."

869.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
869.text: "Lease it to ATO -- until the Valgish threat in the Antacean ceases -- through Lespia."

870.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
870.text: "You'll get Pales in exchange for a tiny island. Not a bad deal if you ask me."

871.speaker: Player_Romus
871.text: "I will extend the pipeline and take care of the costs." [-1 Budget]

876.speaker: Player_Romus
876.text: "I'm sorry but I cannot do neither of those."

880.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
880.text: "Great. And I'll stop our military support."

883.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
883.text: "Then I'm afraid I cannot help you."

888.speaker: Player_Romus
888.text: "How about the sanctions? Can we do something about that as well?"

889.speaker: Player_Romus
889.text: "Thank you, Mr. Alvarez. I'm glad we reached some understanding."

892.speaker: Player_Romus
892.text: "There is no way I can do that. You're being unreasonable."

894.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
894.text: "I'm being more than reasonable against your unjustifiable actions, Your Majesty. But suit yourself."

898.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
898.text: "I would have loved to celebrate but there is nothing to celebrate here, really..."

899.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
899.text: "But I'm happy to maintain our diplomatic ties with you, Mr. Toras. I hope you do not continue this meaningless violence for long."

911.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
911.text: "I believe our support can easily allow Pales to stand their ground. You don't want to deplete your gold reserves in a war of attrition, Your Majesty."
911.conditionsRaw:

912.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
912.text: "Palesian Defence Forces are still in control of key locations like Arces and Ziqes. I'm not sure if things are really looking good for your side."
