916.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
916.text: "As much as I'm not opposed to helping you out, my hands are tied. You must understand my position."
916.conditionsRaw:
(Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Military_Valgsland_AcceptNavalAid"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true  or 
Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true)) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == false) == false)

918.speaker: Player_Romus
918.text: "What will Lespia earn from this? You don't need to do this. Let me make an offer."

919.speaker: Player_Romus
919.text: "I understand your predicament. But Lespians know how to make beneficial deals and I want to offer you one for both of our benefit."

920.speaker: Player_Romus
920.text: "If you're going to continue with your threats, I will end the meeting here."

921.speaker: Narrator
921.text: We both got up from our seats.

922.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
922.text: "I already told you. There is nothing I can do for you."

924.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
924.text: "It is getting pretty late, Your Majesty..."

925.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
925.text: "I'm sorry you came all the way for this."

928.speaker: Player_Romus
928.text: "I understand, Mr. Alvarez. You can officially take on a pro-Pales stance, but I believe we can still arrange something in the background."

929.speaker: Player_Romus
929.text: "I understand your predicament. But Lespians know how to make beneficial deals and I want to offer you one for both of our benefit."

939.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
939.text: "I'm not sure if we can offer any extra money for the Rizian economy at the moment..."

940.speaker: Narrator
940.text: He stopped for a moment to think.

941.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
941.text: "Unless you can give us something that would make the ATO really happy... Caleqabiz."

942.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
942.text: "Lespia would be interested in leasing the island for the ATO."

943.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
943.text: "Alright. We can supply you our gas from 12.50 Arcasian Liras per thousand cubic meters."

948.speaker: Player_Romus
948.text: "That price is a little too steep for me."

949.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
949.text: "Well.. I'm sorry to hear that. Was there anything else?"

951.speaker: Player_Romus
951.text: "Deal." [-4 Budget per Turn, +2 Energy per Turn]

952.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
952.text: "Great to be doing business with you again, Your Majesty. Anything else on your mind?"

953.speaker: Player_Romus
953.text: "Deal. But I only need a short term deal to help us close the current demand." [-4 Budget, +2 Energy]

956.speaker: Player_Romus
956.text: "After going through all that for the Aureus field, I'm not going to hand you the island right next to it."

961.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
961.text: "Seven billion Arcasian Liras. And that's the final offer."

962.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
962.text: "All ownership and extraction rights have already been resolved. The lease will not be disrupting that."

964.speaker: Player_Romus
964.text: "I'm sorry, Mr. Alvarez. I was thinking more about a *conventional* trade deal."

966.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
966.text: "I don't think I can offer Lespian money for anything else at this moment."

968.speaker: Player_Romus
968.text: "I'm afraid I can't agree to that price, Mr. Alvarez."

970.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
970.text: "I understand. Unfortunately I cannot offer anything else at the moment."

973.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
973.text: "Today is turning out to be a great day."

974.speaker: Narrator
974.text: He laughed and drank his whiskey.

975.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
975.text: "You will not regret this decision. I'm sure President Walker will be delighted to hear it as well."

976.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
976.text: "We'll celebrate this decision later. For now... Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?"

977.speaker: Player_Romus
977.text: "If you're not even going to acknowledge it, it will be published, Mr. Alvarez."

979.speaker: Player_Romus
979.text: "For the sake of our relations, I will think about it."

980.speaker: Player_Romus
980.text: "Nothing is for free, Mr. Alvarez. You know that better than me."

981.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
981.text: "You don't want to cut your ties with Lespia like that, Your Majesty."

982.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
982.text: "But fine. If you want an offer, here's one."

983.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
983.text: "You'd be surprised to know who allowed the access to conduct such an operation in the first place. Someone who has been a tremendous asset to Lespian intelligence in the past."

984.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
984.text: "I can provide the name and the documents if you, in exchange, destroy any and all evidence implicating Lespia in the Zille bombing. Agreed?"

985.speaker: Player_Romus
985.text: "Deal. I will destroy the evidence. I need to know this." [Lose Zille Investigation Evidence]

986.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
986.text: "I guarantee you this is something you will want to know. Something that could change your political landscape, even."

987.speaker: Player_Romus
987.text: "No. Mr. Alvarez. You cannot convince me like that. I cannot promise you anything."

988.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
988.text: "Just don't do anything reckless, Your Majesty. Let's not burn bridges."

991.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
991.text: "I was told he has been an asset of the Lespian Intelligence Services for a long time. Before I was even elected."

992.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
992.text: "I will provide you all the necessary evidence before you're on your way back to Rizia, Your Majesty."

993.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
993.text: "It is up to you what to do with that information."

994.speaker: Narrator
994.text: He smiled and we shook hands.

999.speaker: Player_Romus
999.text: "Why not? We've both fallen off the wagon at this point."

1000.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
1000.text: "I'm telling you. No man can survive this job without something to take the edge off."

1032.speaker: Player_Romus
1032.text: "Let's put that to the test, shall we? The moment I walk out of this room, I shall order the publication of the evidence against you."

1034.speaker: Player_Romus
1034.text: "I'm not going to release the evidence now. I will wait until the time is exactly right."

1035.speaker: Player_Romus
1035.text: "Wait. I was bluffing. I'm open to a deal."

1036.speaker: Player_Romus
1036.text: "I'm sorry, Mr. Prime Minister, but the world needs to know about what Lespia did. The evidence will be released."
1036.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Lespia"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_WillVoteYes_MITZ"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true) == false

1037.speaker: Player_Romus
1037.text: "I agree. The evidence we have will remain under wraps. For now."

1041.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
1041.text: "I believe the meeting is over. And I need a drink."

1042.speaker: Narrator
1042.text: He stood up and turned his back to me as he walked away.

1044.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
1044.text: "Do what you must. My government is strong enough to weather the backlash."

1048.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1048.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Lespia"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_WillVoteYes_MITZ"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true) == false

1049.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
1049.text: "And here I was thinking that Rizia and Lespia could reach an understanding for once."

1050.speaker: Player_Romus
1050.text: "Don't worry. I wouldn't be foolish enough to sabotage the deal we made."

1053.speaker: Player_Romus
1053.text: "Oh... I didn't mean whiskey. Can I have water instead?"

1057.speaker: Narrator
1057.text: He prepared two glasses of whiskey and handed me one. We each took a sip.

1058.speaker: Narrator
1058.text: With an annoyed shrug, he took my glass, poured its contents into his own, and refilled it with water.

1067.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
1067.text: "I will take the liberty to say that you've started quite a mess by casting your vote the way you did."

1071.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
1071.text: "As a further gesture of goodwill for this new chapter between our nations, I will arrange for the delivery of some of our advanced air assets and some tanks."
